original_ai_output.title_zh: MRA在Dele Giwa遇刺40年后要求伸张正义
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 媒体权利议程组织（MRA）呼吁尼日利亚联邦政府调查1986年《Newswatch》杂志创始主编Dele Giwa遇刺案，并起诉责任人。Giwa于1986年10月19日在拉各斯Ikeja的住所收到包裹炸弹身亡，案件至今未破。MRA还敦促政府执行2024年2月16日阿布贾联邦高等法院的判决，该判决要求调查此案及其他记者遇害事件。

key_facts.fact: MRA呼吁尼日利亚联邦政府调查1986年Dele Giwa遇刺案并起诉责任人
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Media Rights Agenda (MRA) has called on the Federal Government to investigate the 1986 assassination of founding editor-in-chief of Newswatch magazine, Dele Giwa, and prosecute those responsible

key_facts.fact: Giwa于1986年10月19日在拉各斯Ikeja住所收到包裹炸弹身亡，案件至今未破
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Giwa was killed on October 19, 1986, when a parcel bomb was delivered to his residence in Ikeja, Lagos, and his assassination remains unresolved

key_facts.fact: MRA敦促政府执行2024年2月16日阿布贾联邦高等法院要求调查此案的判决
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: It urged the government to implement a February 16, 2024, judgment of the Federal High Court in Abuja, which ordered an investigation into Giwa’s murder

uncertainties: 案件至今未破，凶手身份及幕后主使尚未确认
目前仅单一来源（International Centre for Investigative Reporting）报道，尚缺乏交叉验证
